$comment: THE ap-home ESTATE — the one deployment the product repo makes: Home on faithchain, `[env.production]` in each apps/*/wrangler.toml, DERIVED from Ring 0's [env.faithnet] by scripts/split/derive-ap-home-env.py at extraction (until the cut; hand-maintained after). This is NOT Faithnet: Faithnet (www.faithnet.me, demo-*-faithnet) is Ring 0's deployment of the same apps and is never deployed from ap-home. What is faithnet's here is only the DNS zone (faithnet.io — the account's; Worker→Worker calls need custom domains, CF error 1042) and the AKCS pilot (the KMS operator's tenant + caller identity, shared with faithnet until the operator binds one for this estate). Ids are not secrets.
$comment_storage: Created by the runbook (docs/runbooks/estate.md §1); the derivation fills these ids in. Never a Ring-0 estate's id — audit every derived block for one.
$comment_vars: Vars whose faithnet value names something faithnet OWNS, re-pointed at this estate; everything not listed is copied (chain contracts, AKCS, budgets, model settings). `drop` removes a var the estate has no value for — email: no zone of its own is onboarded to Email Sending, so the invitation rail is unconfigured (fail-closed) until one is (`EMAIL_FROM` + the send_email binding, or SENDGRID_API_KEY).
$comment_shared: Stays as faithnet's on purpose: ARD_REGISTRY_ORIGIN / DISCOVERY_MCP (discovery.faithnet.io — the public KB, world-readable, another product's); AKCS_* (the pilot's tenant; the shared caller identity is the open trust item); INTERACTIONS_SERVICE_SA / HARNESS_AGENT_SA / AKCS_*_KEY_ID (service agents custodied by that caller identity — they become this estate's own when the operator binds it); PUBLIC_GRAPH_URL (agentkg.io).
$comment_agent_hosts: Per-agent hosts (`<label>.home-a2a.faithnet.io` — A2A_PUBLIC_BASE_DOMAIN on the runtime, AGENT_HOST_PATTERN on home-mcp) answer only once a wildcard DNS record `*.home-a2a.faithnet.io` and a route `*.home-a2a.faithnet.io/*` on home-runtime exist (the shape faithnet.ai has). Until then every agent is reached by its RECORDS through the edge (the rule anyway); only home-mcp's `ap://person/agent-card` resource needs the host.
$comment_rewrites: Comment lines in the derived block that told Ring 0's story, retold for this estate (applied per line, first match wins).

$comment_definitions: Spec 398 §10.3 — the archetype definitions the product relies on, pinned at extraction (agentic.lock.json#definitions) with every tool's authority shape; `ap upgrade` stops for review when any of it changes at the registry. The registry is ~/skills' skills-a2a (faithnet's deployment of it — shared with the estate on purpose, like discovery).
